_: SOLC Survivors (the Games Room arcade machine): each stage a dungeon, unlocked by its game card (clear the dungeon in WoW once). Three rooms, a boss cut out of each room's back wall (the cut is the timer), the hole it leaves the way on; the last is the end boss. Boss loot counts for minting (user). Made by a scratch script; change it here.

loot.what: a piece of the beaten boss's own set you don't own yet; the end boss can also drop its dungeon's chase item

cards.what: clears in WoW (Achievements.lua CLEAR_TIERS): silver and gold play harder with better drops (idea)

moves.what: Rhahk'Zor Slam: a circle under you, then a stunning slam
Smite Stomp: a ring round him that stuns
runs to his chest, kneels (can't be hurt), swaps weapons and comes back faster
a lane lights up, then he charges down it
calls Defias Blackguards down from the wall
Shadow Word: Pain: a shadow bolt; a hit hurts you over time
the hot poker: a circle on you, then a brand that burns
"Tell me... tell me everything!": calls Scarlet Torturers
Flame Spike: three lanes of fire fanning out at you
Fire Nova: a big ring of fire round him, run out
"Release the hounds!": Scarlet Tracking Hounds come running
Bloodlust: faster and fiercer
Polymorph: a circle on you; caught, you're a sheep a moment (slow, no attacks)
Arcane Bubble (can't be hurt), then Detonation: a huge circle to run out of
"Blades of Light!": spins and chases you with a damage ring round him - run
Rushing Charge: a lane, then he charges down it
Frenzy: faster
Scarlet Trainees flood in when he falls
Hammer of Justice: a quick circle on you; caught, stunned
Crusader Strike: a cone in front of him
Divine Shield: can't be hurt a while
Lay on Hands: heals himself back to half, once
Holy Smite: a bolt at you
Deep Sleep: a circle on you; caught, your ogre falls asleep (mash to wake)
"Arise, my champion!": brings Mograine back once
